theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_holder_of_contDiffOn_succ
theorems.statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (h : E₁ → E₂) (V : Set E₁), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1 : ℕ) h V → ∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m h y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
